title: Rioproperty personas
description: A big capital heading and a violet sub-head over four tall photo cards (about 6:7), each with a wide capital title on a dark bottom gradient. On desktop the four columns drift up at four different speeds as you scroll, staggering the row; hovering a card opens a one-line description, shows an up-right arrow and slowly zooms the photo. On phones the cards stack with the line always shown.
notes: each media slot fills its card like object-fit cover; empty, it is a bg-muted placeholder
the card text is paper-white over a dark gradient made from the secondary colour: the photos should be mid-to-dark
the desktop hover behaviour (line opening) is inferred: the capture only shows the titles at 1440
